name: SHARANAM ANIMAL CARE AND RESCUE CENTER
description: Sharanam Animal Care and Rescue Center is a compassionate haven dedicated to the welfare, rehabilitation, and rehoming of animals in need. Our center provides a safe refuge for abandoned, neglected, or abused animals, offering them medical care, nourishment, and love. With a team of dedicated professionals and volunteers, we work tirelessly to rescue, rehabilitate, and find loving forever homes for our furry friends. Committed to promoting responsible pet ownership and animal welfare education, we strive to make a positive impact on both the lives of animals and the community at large. Additionally, we offer reliable and caring pet boarding services, providing peace of mind to pet owners knowing their beloved companions are in good hands

owner_posts.post_text:
Today, a kind-hearted elderly couple visited our center and donated many useful items for our stray babies.  

Their thoughtful contribution may look simple, but for our rescued animals, it means comfort, warmth, care, and love. Every blanket, every item, and every small act of kindness helps us give a better life to these innocent souls.  

We are truly grateful for their generosity and compassion towards stray animals. People like them remind us that kindness has no age — only a beautiful heart.  

Thank you for supporting our stray babies and being a part of their healing journey. 🐾❤️

Thank you so much ma’am for your kindness and generosity towards our animal kids 🐾❤️  
Your donated items will truly help us take better care of them and make their lives more comfortable.  
We deeply appreciate your support and love for these voiceless souls.  
Thank you once again for being part of our rescue family 🙏✨

featured_reviews.name: swapnil shrivastava
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are truly grateful to Sharanam for all the support and guidance provided by Janvi mam during a difficult time for our dog. Through Sharanam, we consulted a doctor who recommended a non-surgical treatment for our dog's bladder stone, whereas other veterinarians had advised immediate surgery. This gave us a valuable alternative to consider and brought us much-needed reassurance.
We also deeply appreciate how responsive and supportive the Sharanam team is. They are always ready to help and show genuine care for every animal under their shelter's care. Although we initially planned to admit our dog, we later realized he would not be comfortable staying away from us. Even then, the team kept us informed about his condition, especially when he was refusing food and needed extra attention.
Thank you to the entire Sharanam team for your compassion, dedication, and continuous support. Your commitment to animal welfare truly makes a difference.

featured_reviews.name: Jyothi Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: Sharanam is absolutely phenomenal! Janvi ma'am is a guardian angel, she welcomed the two rescued pups I brought from Satara with such immense kindness. She showers them with incredible care, consistent vet visits, and regular updates! I'm beyond grateful for her unwavering dedication and just know she'll find them the most loving forever homes! 💖🐾✨🙏😊

featured_reviews.name: Tanmaie Nandurkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
It brings me great comfort knowing my dog is surrounded by so much love and care. Sharanam has given him not just shelter, but a family. Janhavi Sharma and her team are very kind and committed to his well-being which truly means the world to me. I will always be grateful for everything they do for him.” ❤️🐶
Highly recommended for anyone who is looking for not just a foster home but a family who takes care of your pet with love and care.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a truly positive experience with Sharanam Animal Care and Rescue Center. I rescued a 3-month-old indie female dog named Uma who had a head injury, and I was fostering her along with my senior male indie dog. Managing both dogs together became quite challenging due to their age difference and needs.

That’s when I found Sharanam, and I’m genuinely grateful I did. The center is very well-organized and takes care of dogs of all breeds with great dedication. The person managing the center is highly attentive and ensures every dog’s health and safety is properly looked after.

What really stood out to me was the professionalism and compassion of the staff. They have doctors who ensure timely vaccinations and proper medical care, and everyone is polite, approachable, and clearly passionate about animal welfare.

I would highly recommend Sharanam to anyone looking for a safe and caring place for rescued or foster animals. They truly make a difference.

featured_reviews.name: Shruti Gham
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve had a really positive experience with Sharanam Animal Shelter. I have kept my community dog with them for over 2 years, and I’m genuinely grateful for the care she received there.

When I got her back after "treatment" from a well-known NGO, she was extremely malnourished and weak.I was really worried about her well being. Janhavi and the team at Sharanam took the time and effort to nurse her back to health with proper care, attention.

Today, she is healthy, safe, and happily staying there, which gives me a lot of peace of mind.

featured_reviews.name: Jayati Ray Rahane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Sharanam pet boarding is a really safe and good place for temporary or permanent boarding of pets. Ms.Jhanvi and her staff takes care of them like babies. There is always enough food and water for them. The place is also maintained well.
I had to keep our 3 year old Cleo at fostering as we were unable to take care of her for different reasons.
At Sharanam I am happy that our pet was well taken care of ( initially kept in a cage for safety and familiarisation) and had other friends to play with. All medical conditions were treated with utmost care and taken for hospital visits even late night when required.
Hats off to Jhanvi for her dedication to this cause.

featured_reviews.name: Julie Dsilva
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lucy was originally abandoned by my sister and left to fend for herself. Taking pity on her situation, I adopted her. While taking care of her was difficult but it was manageable. The problem though was that she cried for hours whenever I left for work. This led to a lot of complaints from the society. Eventually, I had to look for an adoption agency.

Browsing through Google I found out about Sharanam Animal Care. I was surprised by the number of pet dogs at the facility and that is when I knew I found the right place. Mrs. Jaanvi sends pictures and videos of Lucy and schedules a video call whenever I request for one. She also took Lucy to the doctor , did blood tests and gave appropriate medicine when she was sick & unable to walk.
Mrs Jaanvi is very good at taking care of the pets. I am very happy that my Lucy is in safe hands.

featured_reviews.name: Merlyn Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: This puppy is a stray from my society who was found sick and left to die. When I came to know about her, I took her to a nearby hospital who did some tests and said that she might die as she has parvo disease and were not ready to keep her. I could not take her home as i have 2 cats and I did not want to give up on her as well. So one of my friends recommended me to speak to Ms.Jhanvi from Sharanam Animal Welfare Centre. When I spoke to Jhanvi, she heard all the details and immediately asked me to get the pup to her shelter. There was no hesitation from her side to help us. Once I got the pup to her, she examined her state and said she will take care of her as her own..I don't have words to express my gratitude to Ms.Jhanvi who came as a ray of hope for me when I wasnt able to understand what to do with the pup,. I had no heart to leave her to die. I thank Ms. Jhanvi for taking the pup in and caring for her and now with the care given, the pup (now named MISHTI by Jhanvi) has not only survived but is doing great at the shelter. As Mishti is small Ms. Jhanvi has agreed to take care of her till she gets older or gets adopted. Once again thank you Ms. Jhanvi and Sharanam Animal Welfare Centre and my heartfelt gratitude for this amazing work that you are doing for the voiceless. 🙏

name: Rroaming Paws FOUNDATION
description:
Rroaming Paws Foundation is a registered animal welfare NGO dedicated to sterilisation (ABC), anti-rabies vaccination, rescue, rehabilitation, and community awareness across Mumbai, Vasai-Virar, and Maharashtra. Our mission is to build safe, compassionate, and rabies-free communities by protecting street animals through ethical, transparent, and science-based practices.
We work closely with feeders, societies, volunteers, and municipal bodies to ensure every community dog and cat receives proper care, medical support, and lifelong protection. Support us in creating a more compassionate world for all animals.

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best and genuine animal welfare NGOs I’ve come across. I discovered them in 2021 and have seen them grow tremendously over time. What makes them truly special is their team - including school and college students, working professionals, and dedicated animal lovers across age groups, all coming together for a common cause.

I’ve had the opportunity to closely work with the team, and their dedication is truly commendable. Animal welfare isn’t easy, it involves making tough and critical decisions but they continue to give their best and often go out of their way to help animals. Truly inspiring work!

featured_reviews.name: richa sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
A heartfelt thank you to Founder Sushank and CAP Organisation for giving this sweet soul the better life she truly deserved. From severe skin infection to healing and hope, Mili’s transformation (before and after pic) says it all. She is a street dog near our apartment, and today she has a new chance at life. Every soul on the streets deserves love, dignity, and care, and CAP continues to serve this cause in every way they can.

This is not the only case they have helped us with—they have supported 2–3 more dogs as well, always stepping in selflessly. They never asked us for donations for treatment, but we felt it was our responsibility to contribute and support such genuine work.

Requesting everyone to please support them in whatever way possible. They may not have big backing, but they have big hearts. ♥️

featured_reviews.review_text:

customer_updates.name: Vijay Patil
customer_updates.text:
ज़रूरी सूचना / Urgent Notice
हिन्दी:
नमस्ते,
मैंने एक कुत्ते को देखा है जिसे तुरंत मदद की ज़रूरत है।
कुत्ते की स्थिति:
* वह बीमार दिख रहा है।
* वह अस्वाभाविक रूप से व्यवहार कर रहा था (मेरे पीछे आ रहा था, दूसरे कुत्तों पर हमला कर रहा था)।
* उसके मुँह से लार या झाग निकल रहा था।
* वह बहुत आक्रामक लग रहा था।
कृपया जल्द से जल्द इसकी मदद करें।
धन्यवाद।
English:
Hello,
I have seen a dog that urgently needs help.
Dog's Condition:
* It appears to be sick.
* It was behaving unusually (following me, attacking other dogs).
* There was saliva or foam coming from its mouth.
* It seemed very aggressive.
Please provide assistance as soon as possible.
Thank you.
मराठी:
नमस्कार,
मला एक कुत्रा दिसला आहे ज्याला त्वरित मदतीची गरज आहे.
कुत्र्याची स्थिती:
* तो आजारी दिसत आहे.
* तो असामान्यपणे वागत होता (माझ्या मागे येत होता, इतर कुत्र्यांवर हल्ला करत होता).
* त्याच्या तोंडातून लाळ किंवा फेस बाहेर येत होता.
* तो खूप आक्रमक वाटत होता.
कृपया लवकरच याला मदत करा.
धन्यवाद.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
This NGO truly sets a gold standard in social service. Their team is upfront, proactive, and available 24×7, which is rare and incredibly reassuring. No matter the time or situation, they step in immediately and take responsibility rather than making excuses.

What really stands out is their willingness to go the extra mile—sometimes even beyond what is expected or required—to ensure real help reaches those in need. Their work is driven by compassion, transparency, and action, not just words.

It’s organizations like this that restore faith in humanity. Deep respect and gratitude to the entire team for their tireless dedication and selfless service. Highly recommended and truly trustworthy. 🌟

featured_reviews.review_text: I had a great experience with Animal Rescue and Shelter Foundation. They took very good care of my three cats, making sure they were well-fed, comfortable, and safe. The shelter was clean and hygienic, and the team was very kind and caring towards the animals. I truly appreciate their dedication and would definitely recommend them.

featured_reviews.name: namrata katwankar
featured_reviews.review_text: Thank you for the incredible work you do for helpless kittens and abandoned animals. Your kindness, care, and dedication are truly inspiring. Because of your efforts, many innocent lives get a second chance to live safely and happily. The world really needs more people and foundations like yours. Keep doing this amazing work. 🐾❤️

featured_reviews.name: Azim Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t thank this animal shelter enough for the incredible help they gave me during a very stressful night. When I was in urgent need and didn’t know where to turn, they stepped in with compassion, professionalism, and genuine care for my Labrador.

Even at night, their team was responsive, calm, and incredibly kind. They treated my dog as if he were their own, which immediately put me at ease. In a moment of panic, their support meant everything to me.

This shelter isn’t just a place for animals — it’s a place full of people with big hearts who truly care. I’ll always be grateful for their night-time help and would highly recommend them to anyone who needs support for their pet in an emergency.

featured_reviews.name: Pratiksha Gurav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I do NOT recommend this rescue service at all.
I found a small puppy on the road and took care of him for almost a month with proper food and attention. Trusting them, I handed him over for rescue, as they assured me of proper care, checkup, and vaccination.
However, after they took the puppy, they completely stopped answering calls and messages. When we personally visited their location later, we were shocked to see the puppy’s condition had become much worse. There was no proper care, no medical treatment, and no vaccination as promised.
This is extremely irresponsible and heartbreaking. Please do not trust them with any animal’s life. Animals deserve love and proper care, not neglect like this.

featured_reviews.name: dhiraj tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when help is needed not tomorrow, not in the morning—but right now. This NGO was a true lifesaver for me at midnight, when I had almost lost hope. They didn’t just respond quickly; they responded with genuine care, empathy, and respect.

A very special mention to Bhavesh, the real protagonist who stepped in and treated me with incredible hospitality and kindness. He made sure I felt safe, supported, and heard—something you never forget in times of distress.

This organization doesn’t just “help” people; they stand by you when it matters most. If you’re ever in need or looking to support an NGO that truly makes a difference on the ground, I wholeheartedly recommend them. Eternal gratitude 🙏✨

I met Mr mohan he is very helpful...
He saved 2 kitties from our area came for immediate assistance formalities were very smooth.. one of the best organisation for animal rescue and adoption center..

featured_reviews.name: Khushi Kachalia
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a stray kitten that no one was willing to adopt, her mom had died and we just picked her up off the street with no knowledge of how to care for her. We couldn't keep her because we could not transport her back to our home, and we already had a dog. She had fleas and worms and we were terrified about what to do for her. We called ARAS in the morning and they got back to us immediately and in the next 2-3 hours the founder came to pick her up. He even explained that you may video call the foundation or request pictures to check in on the animal. The work these people are doing is incredible, and the complaints about the request for donations is completely unjustified. Pets are expensive, these people are paying rent for a property as well as feeding, grooming, and giving medical care to over some 60 animals. A big thank you to Bhavesh Jain and everyone else working for this foundation ! As for Ginger, I hope someone will adopt her, she's very sweet, loves to cuddle and only 1.5-2 months old. There are pictures of her below, and if you are interested go ahead and give this number a call. 😄

featured_reviews.name: GM Lotlikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am totally disappointed and heartbroken with my experience at Yoda NGO situated at Malad Chikuwadi. I had sent my cat for sterilization and kept following up from day one, but my messages and calls were continuously ignored. Despite my repeated requests for updates, I wasn’t informed about my cat’s condition or whereabouts.

After 15 days of constant follow-ups, I was shocked to learn that my cat had been released five days earlier without any prior intimation or confirmation from me. To make things worse, my cat was left without my permission in a location that is extremely difficult to find. This is extremely irresponsible and careless behavior.

Animals are not just “cases” they are family. My cat was like my baby.  I had some emotional sentiments connection with my cat. NGOs like Yoda are expected to show compassion, transparency, and accountability, not negligence. What happened to my cat should never happen to anyone else.

featured_reviews.name: Shreekant Bhosale
featured_reviews.review_text:
I brought an injured stray cat to this NGO today, thinking they might offer free treatment, as many NGOs do. The team was responsive and treated the cat with two antibiotic injections, which I truly appreciate.

However, I was charged ₹300 for the visit, which caught me off guard. As a medical student, I have some understanding of the cost of basic injectable antibiotics, and I felt the price was on the higher side for what was administered.

I’m not questioning their intentions — I understand NGOs need to sustain their operations, and nothing runs for free. Still, as a student with no income and someone who acted purely out of compassion, it was a bit disheartening.

I had even quarrelled with my family to bring the cat home and do what I could. I wish the cost had been clearly mentioned when I called earlier, so I could have been prepared.

That said, I respect the work they are doing for animals. This review is not meant to discredit them, but to help others like me — especially students — know that it's better to ask about charges beforehand. I hope someday I’ll be in a position to contribute more meaningfully to such causes.
